objective: Execute RSR-06 — LNG Language/Culture/Script Reconciliation. Audit all 24 retained sources for languages, dialects, registers, naming systems, scripts, lexicon/phrases, pronunciation, etymology, cultural language use, language-history and timeline-dependent linguistic evidence; reconcile material against completed LNG-01..06 and current World/Timeline/Character-knowledge/visibility authorities. Reuse established language/script identities where supported; preserve owner statements and explicit corrections; keep assistant-generated words, names, scripts, translations, language-family claims and etymologies proposal-only unless independently supported or later owner-approved; and route culture/world/profession/supernatural/final-coverage implications without creating a duplicate language registry or leaking future/hidden language knowledge.
required_inputs: completed_verified RSR-02 World/Reality/Timeline reconciliation for chronology and setting identity
completed_verified LNG-01..06 language/linguistics foundation and its temporal/visibility boundaries
owner-authority rule: explicit owner statements/corrections outrank surrounding assistant-generated prose
completion_gate: All 24 retained sources receive an RSR-06 LNG relevance decision. Every material language/culture/script source is linked to existing LNG/World/Timeline/Character-knowledge authority, preserved as a noncanonical source-bound proposal, queued for conflict/uncertainty, or rerouted. Existing stable language/script identities are reused; missing vocabulary/grammar remains unknown rather than fabricated; historical/future language stages do not leak into inappropriate eras or visibility scopes; downstream RSR-07/WCI/DPL/SGC and other owning routes are recorded; exact-head AIOC repository-health validation passes.
nonauthorization: MSS-06 or later MSS implementation before completed_verified RSR-07
automatic canon promotion of assistant-generated lexicon, names, scripts, translations, dialects, language families, etymologies or linguistic histories
duplicate language/script registry creation or silent stable-ID creation
future/historical/GM-hidden language leakage into present-era Character knowledge, search, AI context or player-visible output
